steps: Mo /products/new
Quan sat 6 field: Product title, Internal name (optional), Internal tags (optional), Fulfillment provider, Fulfillment catalog ID, Description
Kiem tra DOM co dau *, aria-required tren field nao khong

checks.expected_result: Hien du 6 field; khong field nao co dau hieu bat buoc trong DOM (khong *, khong aria-required)

checks.title: Product title pre-fill gia tri that ('Example MUG'), khong phai placeholder
steps: Mo /products/new
Kiem tra input.value cua Product title (khong chi nhin placeholder)
Bam Save ma khong sua gi
Quan sat product base duoc tao co ten gi

steps: Dien Product title, Internal name, Internal tags, Description
Bam Save
Quan sat payload POST /api/products

Quan sat URL sau redirect
Quan sat wizard 'Step 1/3 Upload Mockup... Skip / Next'
Quan sat request PUT /api/user/guide-config
checks.observation_point: URL, noi dung wizard, request guide-config
checks.expected_result: Redirect sang /products/{id}/edit kem wizard 'Step 1/3 Upload Mockup... Skip / Next'; trang thai wizard ghi qua PUT /api/user/guide-config

checks.title: Product title rong khi Save tra toast loi + response 422, khong co inline field error

steps: Xoa sach Product title
Bam Save
Quan sat co redirect khong
Quan sat toast hien thi
Quan sat response POST /api/products
Quan sat DOM co inline field error/highlight khong
checks.observation_point: Toast text, response status/body, DOM field state
checks.expected_result: Khong redirect; toast 'Error'/'Product title is required.'; response 422 {message, errors.title:[...]}; DOM KHONG co inline field error, khong highlight field

checks.title: Multiselect Fulfillment provider khong co cach bo chon ve trang thai 'Others' (blank) sau khi da chon

steps: Chon 1 fulfillment provider (vd Gearment)
Tim nut/hanh dong de bo chon ve trang thai blank ('Others')
checks.observation_point: Su hien dien cua nut X / hanh dong clear tren multiselect
checks.expected_result: Khong co nut X de bo chon; khong quay lai duoc trang thai blank ('Others') tu form nay (phai reload trang de reset)

checks.title: Product title voi gia tri bien (whitespace-only, rat dai) - whitespace-only da CONFIRMED, do dai van chua test
steps: Nhap title toan khoang trang (whitespace-only, vd ' '), bam Save, quan sat ket qua
Nhap title rat dai (vd >255 ky tu), bam Save, quan sat ket qua
checks.observation_point: Response API (co request duoc gui khong) + gia tri title hien thi lai sau khi luu
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED cho phan whitespace-only (PO xac nhan 'case toan whitespace thi coi la khong co title -> khong save duoc', 2026-09-13 ): khi title chi gom khoang trang, client CHAN HOAN TOAN, KHONG co request POST /api/products nao duoc gui, san pham KHONG duoc tao. Phan title RAT DAI (vd >255 ky tu) VAN CHUA XAC DINH - can dieu tra rieng, khong duoc suy dien tu ket qua whitespace. LUU Y: phan ky tu dac biet/HTML cua boundary nay DA duoc tach thanh check rieng CHK-02-014 (SEC-002) - khong con thuoc pham vi check nay.
risk_refs: FEAT-02 unknown_areas: do dai title (>255) van la coverage_gap

checks.title: Cac field khac ngoai Product title de trong khong bi chan o server (BASELINE, 10/10 sample)
checks.precondition: Dang o /products/new, Product title co gia tri hop le
steps: Tao 10 product base test chi dien Product title, de trong Internal name/tags, Fulfillment provider/catalog ID, Description
Quan sat response API cho tung lan tao
Doi chieu voi Printarea (de trong Display name) va Variant (de trong Weight/Compare price, thieu SKU)
checks.observation_point: Response API cho 10 lan tao product base + 2 doi chieu Printarea/Variant
checks.expected_result: Hien tai quan sat thay (BASELINE, lần khảo sát): 10/10 POST /api/products deu tra 201 khi de trong moi field ngoai Product title - xac nhan server KHONG bat buoc field nao khac ngoai title o buoc tao Product Base. Voi Printarea: de trong 'Display name' van tao thanh cong (dung default 'Front'/1400x1400). Voi Variant: de trong Weight/Compare price van tao thanh cong khi du SKU/Color/Size/Price; import file thieu SKU tra loi ro rang 'SKU is required in row 2'. PO chi de nghi 'thu lần khảo sát case de validate' (instruction, khong assertion cu the ve ket qua) nen du evidence manh (10 mau) KHONG duoc nang len CONFIRMED_EXPECTED - lech khoi baseline nay can dieu tra.
risk_refs: FEAT-02 unknown_areas: required field (nay da co baseline 10 mau)

checks.title: Baseline: server tu set nhieu field mac dinh (im lang) khi tao product base
checks.precondition: Tao product base khong chon fulfillment provider, khong gui Internal name
steps: Submit form /products/new hop le, khong dien Internal name, khong chon fulfillment provider
Quan sat response 201: status, had_back, enable_custom_printarea, color_display_type, size_display_type, label
checks.observation_point: Cac field mac dinh trong response POST /api/products
checks.expected_result: BASELINE: response 201 co status=0, had_back=false, enable_custom_printarea=false, color_display_type='radio', size_display_type='radio'; khi khong gui Internal name, server set label = title. Dung de theo doi neu default value doi ngoai y muon o cac lần khảo sát sau

checks.title: Baseline: khoi 'Advanced options' luon disabled tren form New (bat ke da chon provider hay chua)
steps: Quan sat trang thai nut 'Advanced options' khi chua chon provider
Chon 1 provider (vd Gearment), quan sat lai trang thai nut
checks.observation_point: Trang thai enabled/disabled cua nut Advanced options
checks.expected_result: BASELINE: nut 'Advanced options' luon disabled tren /products/new, ca khi da chon provider Gearment. Dung de theo doi neu hanh vi nay doi o cac lần khảo sát sau

checks.title: [Business decision] 'Advanced options' duoc nap tu du lieu import cua nha in; TeeInBlue khong phu trach yeu cau fulfillment cu the tung nha in
checks.precondition: Khong can - day la quyet dinh san pham do PO xac nhan truc tiep
steps: Khong can thuc hien evidence-gathering them; PO da xac nhan truc tiep day la NO_EXPLORATION_NEEDED
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED (PO xac nhan truc tiep, 2026-09-13, NO_EXPLORATION_NEEDED): 'Advanced options' cua Product Base duoc lay trong luc import san pham tu nha in ve; khi fulfill can mot so thong tin trong Advanced options moi fulfill duoc, nhung dieu nay tuy tung san pham va do nha in quy dinh - app TeeInBlue KHONG phu trach phan do. Day la quyet dinh san pham/business rule, KHONG phai gap ky thuat can lam ro them; bien nao thuc su bat/tat 'Advanced options' (fulfillment_id/is_imported/catalog ID) khong con la cau hoi uu tien vi ban chat tinh nang da duoc PO giai thich.
risk_refs: KB-020 unclear-condition (da dong theo business decision KB-070)
